description: This file extends CanvasWindowController with implementations of WKNavigationDelegate methods to manage web view navigation decisions, handle deep links, and control URL opening behavior within a macOS application.

methods.name: webView(_:decidePolicyFor:decisionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles navigation actions in the WKWebView, deciding whether to allow, cancel, or handle URLs internally or externally based on schemes and context.

methods.name: webView(_:didFinish:)
methods.description: Called when a web view finishes navigation; triggers debug status application if needed.
